description: Slack public channels through the credential proxy proxy. Messages and thread replies come from search.messages (Tier 2): one query per sync window names every public channel (in:#a in:#b … is an OR), so a sync costs a few calls however many channels there are. Requires the configured operator credential proxy.

value.parameters: {{ [{'name': 'query', 'value': 'in:#' ~ (stream_slice.extra_fields['name'] | join(' in:#')) ~ ' after:' ~ format_datetime(str_to_datetime(stream_interval.start_time) - duration('P1D'), '%Y-%m-%d') ~ ' before:' ~ format_datetime(str_to_datetime(stream_interval.end_time) + duration('P1D'), '%Y-%m-%d'), 'type': 'query'}, {'name': 'count', 'value': '100', 'type': 'query'}, {'name': 'sort', 'value': 'timestamp', 'type': 'query'}, {'name': 'sort_dir', 'value': 'asc', 'type': 'query'}, {'name': 'highlight', 'value': 'false', 'type': 'query'}, {'name': 'page', 'value': '%d' % (next_page_token.next_page_token if next_page_token else 1), 'type': 'query'}] }}

record_filter.condition: {{ record.get('ts') is not none and not (record.get('channel') or {}).get('is_private') and not (record.get('channel') or {}).get('is_im') and not (record.get('channel') or {}).get('is_mpim') and not ('thread_ts=' in (record.get('permalink') or '') and ('thread_ts=' ~ record.ts) not in record.permalink) }}

fields.value: {{ record.permalink.split('thread_ts=')[1].split('&')[0] if record.get('permalink') and 'thread_ts=' in record.permalink else (record.get('thread_ts') or '') }}
